notes: The published int8 file of litert-community/decider-2b-vision-LiteRT (Hub commit 6c024e94) through the Android library again (#176 shape), now in the sample's photo form: the user's own photo (sent at a long side of 768 px) and a typed question with options, one letter back, then a text-only follow-up question in the same conversation; a chart turn and a Stop (cancel while generating, then a new conversation on a reloaded model) are steps of the same check. The device check runs in the instrumentation process; the app on screen loaded the GPU profile in 38.0-44.0 s against 59.9-60.1 s here (cause not isolated), so screen numbers are not entered. Walls as #176(2): latency_p50_ms and ttft_ms null, the answer, conversation and load walls in metrics; output_match null (letters, #173(2)); full_delegation null (the check keeps no delegate line; the SDK's ready line names language=GPU vision=GPU for the gpu profile). rerun_* = the supervisor's rerun of the gpu check on the same day (01:08-01:11 JST, the model already in the app's store). A new conversation per request on one load keeps the LiteRT-LM#3165 state, so every new picture and every Stop reloads.
quantization: dynamic int8 fully connected weights, int8 token embedding (channelwise); vision encoder and adapter fp16; fp32 activation preference declared on the decoder section
